tool.name: annotateMyIDs
tool.description: Annotate a list of IDs using Bioconductor annotation data packages.
tool.command: Rscript -e "library(BiocManager); BiocManager::install('org.Hs.eg.db'); library(org.Hs.eg.db); args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE); input_file <- args[1]; output_file <- args[2]; header <- as.logical(args[3]); ids <- read.table(input_file, header=header, sep='\t')[,1]; annotations <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys=ids, column=c('ENTREZID', 'SYMBOL', 'GENENAME'), keytype='ENSEMBL', multiVals='first'); write.table(annotations, file=output_file, sep='\t', quote=FALSE, col.names=NA)"

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input File
param.help: Tab-delimited file with identifiers in the first column.

tool.help: This tool annotates a list of IDs using Bioconductor annotation data packages. Supported organisms include human, mouse, rat, fruit fly, and zebrafish.
